The '''Junobia system''' was located in the [[Keldrath sector/Legends|Keldrath sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Species/Legends|species]] known as [[Junobian soft-shell sand flier]].<ref name="Idol" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Junobia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square T-6.<ref name="TEA" />
